style: Dark fantasy horror illustration for a retro game, wide landscape composition. Strictly monochrome: pure black, charcoal grey, light grey and off-white only, plus blood red used ONLY on the elements listed as red. No other colours, no blue, brown, sepia or warm tint anywhere. Strong chiaroscuro: mostly deep black darkness, one dim light source, very high contrast. Large, simple, clearly readable shapes and silhouettes with minimal fine texture and no tiny details, because the image will be shrunk to 336x200 pixels. Flat graphic shading in three or four tones, like a woodcut or ink wash, crisp edges. Every element listed as red must be bold and clearly visible, because tiny red details disappear when shrunk, but red should cover only a small part of the image unless the scene says otherwise. Main characters should be large in the frame unless the scene says they are small. Keep every important subject inside the central horizontal band; the top and bottom 6% will be cropped. No text, no letters, no runes, no logo, no frame, no border, no UI, no signature, no watermark. Not anime or manga style: no big eyes, no cute or stylised faces; realistic human proportions and restrained, naturalistic faces, like a classic dark fantasy book illustration or etching. Not pixel art and no pixel grid (it will be pixelized afterwards).

HERO.name: the hooded adventurer
HERO.look: a lone adventurer in a long dark hooded cloak; the face is completely hidden in black shadow inside the hood except for two tiny white glowing dots for eyes; carries a small lantern and a short sword; slim, ordinary human size

GIRL.name: the ghost girl
GIRL.look: a girl about six years old, pale and faintly translucent, in a long plain white nightgown, barefoot, shoulder-length dark hair, a small crown-shaped royal crest pendant on her chest; she casts no shadow

KNIGHT.name: the ghost knight
KNIGHT.look: half-transparent and faintly glowing, in battered rusted plate armour with a torn tabard bearing a crown crest; the open helmet is empty inside, no face; carries a longsword

QUEEN.name: the queen
QUEEN.look: a woman with long loose hair in a long pale gown

jobs.name: e008
jobs.prompt: In a dark stone corridor, {GIRL} stands facing the wall, crying with her hands over her face. Her small body glows faintly white against the darkness, and the floor beneath her shows no shadow at all. Red only: the tiny crest pendant on her chest.

jobs.name: g025
jobs.ja: 骨の門番（地下25階の門番）
jobs.prompt: A colossal gate built entirely from countless human bones and skulls fills the whole width of a crypt. Skeletal hands reach out from the gate. At its centre a huge skull with glowing eye sockets looks down. {HERO} is tiny at the bottom centre, seen from behind. Red only: the glowing eye sockets of the skulls.

jobs.name: n02
jobs.prompt: An old round stone tower that has sunk into the ground and leans to one side, standing alone in darkness. A small iron-barred window. A crude medieval plague cross is daubed in paint on its heavy wooden door (a simple rough cross, NOT a biohazard symbol, nothing modern), which stands half open, and inside a small empty bed is visible. No people. Red only: the painted cross on the door.

jobs.name: e020_0_r
jobs.ja: 黒い犬→干し肉をやる：犬が隣を歩く
jobs.prompt: Side view: {HERO} walks to the right down a dark corridor with a thin black dog trotting at their side. The dog has one glowing eye. Red only: the dog's one eye.

jobs.name: g100_0_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→真の結末：母と娘の再会
jobs.prompt: In a column of soft light rising out of darkness, {QUEEN} kneels and embraces {GIRL} tightly; both have their eyes closed, peaceful. Behind them {KNIGHT} kneels with his sword planted, head bowed. In the background the giant eye is cracked and crumbling into dust. Red only: the cracks of the broken eye.

jobs.name: title
jobs.ja: タイトル画面：深淵へ続く螺旋階段と赤い眼
jobs.prompt: A worn stone staircase spiralling down into a bottomless black abyss, seen from above at a steep angle; the steps fade into darkness. Far above the depth, a single huge eye opens in the dark. No people. Red only: the iris of the eye and its faint glow.

jobs.name: e001
jobs.prompt: {HERO} stands small at the left of a narrow stone corridor, facing a massive iron door at the dead end. The door is heavy, studded, slightly ajar with a thin black gap. Light from the adventurer's lantern. Red only: the rust streaks on the door.

jobs.name: e023
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT} stands motionless in a ruined corridor with his head bowed, both hands resting on the pommel of a longsword planted point-down. {HERO} is small in the left foreground, seen from behind, looking at him. Red only: the crown crest on the knight's tabard.

jobs.name: e027
jobs.ja: 子守唄（ひとりでに揺れる揺りかご）
jobs.prompt: A dark, empty stone room. In the corner an ornate wooden baby cradle rocks by itself, surrounded by a faint pale glow. The wood grain of the cradle looks subtly alive, like veins. A crown crest is carved on the headboard. Nobody is there. Red only: the carved crest on the cradle.

jobs.name: gameover
jobs.prompt: A large human skull lying on a dark crypt floor, lit from above, dust and darkness all around, blood dripping from the jaw. Red only: two tiny lights deep in the eye sockets and the dripping blood.

jobs.name: g075
jobs.ja: 深淵の竜（地下75階の門番）
jobs.prompt: A huge dragon made of bones and rotting flesh spreads its tattered wings over a bottomless chasm. {HERO} is tiny on a rock ledge at the bottom, facing it. Red only: the fire burning in the dragon's eye sockets and a faint glow inside its ribcage.

jobs.name: e096
jobs.ja: あの夜の部屋（記憶の病室）
jobs.prompt: A small quiet sickroom remembered from long ago: a child's white bed with rumpled sheets, a single flower in a vase on the windowsill, and a wooden chair beside the pillow. The window shows only pure black nothingness. Soft light falls only on the bed. No people. Red only: the flower.

jobs.name: g100
jobs.prompt: The bottom of the labyrinth: a gigantic single eye opens at the centre of the darkness. The surrounding walls are made of organic flesh, and set into the flesh above is one large serene face of a sleeping woman with her eyes closed. {HERO} stands small at the bottom centre, seen from behind. Red only: the iris of the giant eye and the veins around it.

jobs.name: e001_2_ng
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→耳を当てる（失敗）：扉の向こうから「開けて」
jobs.prompt: Close-up: {HERO} had pressed an ear to a rusted iron door and is now recoiling in fear. From the thin black gap of the door, long pale thin fingers are reaching out of the darkness. Red only: the rust on the door.

jobs.name: e011_1_ng
jobs.ja: 落とし穴→跳ぶ（失敗）：縁にしがみつく
jobs.prompt: {HERO} clings to the crumbling edge of a black pit in a stone corridor floor, hanging by the hands with legs dangling over bottomless darkness, small pieces of stone falling. Red only: blood on one knee.

jobs.name: e008_0_r
jobs.ja: 迷子の少女→手を差し伸べる：少女が手を握る
jobs.prompt: {HERO} kneels in a dark corridor holding the small hand of {GIRL}, who looks up at the adventurer. A gentle faint glow surrounds the girl. Red only: the tiny crest pendant on her chest.

jobs.name: e037_0_r
jobs.ja: 渡し守→金貨を払う：舟で地底湖を渡る
jobs.prompt: A small wooden boat on a still black underground lake. A tall hooded ferryman stands at the stern rowing with a long oar, and {HERO} sits in the boat. Thin mist on the water, distant cave walls. Red only: a small lantern hanging at the bow.

jobs.name: e046_0_r
jobs.ja: 少女の墓→花を手向ける：少女が光に溶ける
jobs.prompt: A small crude gravestone carved with a crown crest in a dark crypt. {GIRL} stands before it holding a small flower to her chest and smiling, her body dissolving upward into motes of light. {HERO} kneels nearby. Red only: the flower.

jobs.name: n02_1_r
jobs.prompt: Inside a cramped round stone tower cell, the walls are covered with a small child's simple chalk drawings: a mother and child holding hands, a house, a moon, stars (no letters, no writing). A small empty bed. {HERO} holds up a lantern, looking at the wall. Red only: the drawing of the mother and child.

jobs.name: g075_1_r
jobs.ja: 深淵の竜→騎士を呼ぶ：騎士の亡霊が竜に斬りかかる
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT} leaps from beside the adventurer at a huge skeletal dragon above a chasm, sword raised high, glowing ghostly white. {HERO} stands in the foreground watching. Red only: the fire in the dragon's eye sockets.

jobs.name: e002
jobs.prompt: A narrow stone corridor whose floor is flooded by a river of hundreds of grey rats flowing toward the viewer. {HERO} stands at the right with the lantern raised as the rats part around their boots. Red only: the eyes of the rats, drawn as many bold bright dots all turned toward the viewer.

jobs.name: e003
jobs.prompt: The skeleton of a dead adventurer sits slumped against a dungeon wall, still wearing a rusted helmet and a tattered cloak, a broken sword and a pack beside it. One bony finger points down at a particular floor stone. Lantern light from the left. No living people. Red only: a large red smear on the floor stone the finger points at.

jobs.name: e004
jobs.prompt: A bare, empty stone room. In the very centre stands a magnificent ornate treasure chest, far too splendid for such a place, lit by a single shaft of light, with heavy iron bands and a big lock. No people. Red only: a large gem set into the lock of the chest.

jobs.name: e005
jobs.prompt: An old round stone well in the middle of a dark room, its rim cracked and mossy, a rope and bucket hanging above it. Pale mist rises from the black depth. {HERO} leans over the rim, looking down into it. Red only: a red glow deep inside the well.

jobs.name: e006
jobs.prompt: A fork in a cave with two dark tunnels. A gaunt, grotesque goblin with long ears and a hooked nose sleeps sitting against the rock, hugging a crude spear. Stolen goods are scattered at its feet: coins, a boot, a helmet and a sack, all in greys. Not cute. Red only: a small strip of red cloth tied just below the spearhead, clearly visible but covering only a small part of the image; everything else, including the sack, is grey.

jobs.name: e007
jobs.prompt: Moss-covered pillars surround an old black stone altar in a ruined shrine, with a few candle stubs. The altar top is covered in layers of dried stains running down its sides. No people. Red only: the dried blood stains on the altar, large and dripping down its sides.

jobs.name: e009
jobs.prompt: A small campfire still smouldering in a cave: glowing embers, a thin trail of smoke, a log seat and an abandoned bedroll beside it, and nobody around. The firelight is the only light. Red only: the glowing embers and the small flames.

jobs.name: e010
jobs.prompt: A tall hooded peddler with no visible face, only darkness under the hood, holds up a lantern and beckons with a long bony hand. A huge pack of strange goods is strapped to their back: bottles, bundles and hanging trinkets. Dark stone room. Large in the frame. Red only: the small flame inside the lantern glass. The peddler's robe, sleeves, arms and hands are black and grey with no red on them at all.

jobs.name: e012
jobs.prompt: A stone corridor blocked by a huge, thick white spider web. Several silk-wrapped cocoons hang in it, and one bulges as if something is moving inside. In the darkness of the ceiling, the long hairy legs of a giant spider are barely visible. {HERO} stands small in the foreground, facing the web. Red only: a cluster of eight large glowing spider eyes in the ceiling darkness.

jobs.name: e013
jobs.prompt: A hall lined with tall mirrors. {HERO} stands in the left half of the frame, exhausted. The largest mirror fills the right half, and the reflection in it is slightly out of step: its hand is raised while the real adventurer's hand is down, and its head is tilted differently. The reflection is large and close. Red only: the two eyes of the reflection glow bright red, drawn big and bold with a red glow around them, instead of white.

jobs.name: e020
jobs.prompt: A thin, gaunt black dog emerges from the darkness of a stone corridor and stands still, staring straight at the viewer without growling. Low camera, the dog large in the frame. Red only: one of the dog's eyes glows red; the other eye is dark and normal.

jobs.name: e021
jobs.prompt: A rotting wooden desk in a dark abandoned room, with a single sheet of note paper on it, lit by a candle stub. The writing on the paper is only blurred, illegible scribbles with no readable letters. A broken wax seal is stuck at the corner of the paper. No people. Red only: the broken wax seal, large.

jobs.name: e031
jobs.prompt: A ruined bell tower. A huge bell hangs from a cracked wooden beam, and countless names are engraved all around its rim, shown only as rows of tiny scratches, never as readable letters. {HERO} stands below, looking up at it. Red only: a red glow on one small spot of the bell's rim, a glowing smudge with no letters or symbols in it. Absolutely no writing, letters or alphabet anywhere in the image.

jobs.name: e037
jobs.prompt: The shore of a black underground lake. A tall hooded ferryman stands beside a small wooden boat moored at the water's edge, holding a long oar and holding out an open bony hand toward the viewer to ask for payment. Mist on the water. Red only: a small lantern hanging at the boat's bow.

jobs.name: e039
jobs.prompt: A swamp witch in a cave hut: a hunched old crone with wild grey hair and a crooked toothy grin stirs a big bubbling cauldron, with herbs and bones hanging from the low ceiling. Realistic and grotesque, not cartoonish. Large in the frame. Red only: the glowing liquid in the cauldron.

jobs.name: e045
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT}, now very faint and flickering, far more transparent than before, leans against a dungeon wall with one hand on the stone and his head lowered; the edges of the armour dissolve into mist. Large in the frame. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard.

jobs.name: e046
jobs.prompt: A small, crude gravestone carved with a crown crest stands in a dark crypt; it looks artificial, like a stage prop. {GIRL} stands before it, looking down at the darkness at her feet. {HERO} stands a little behind her. Red only: the crest carved on the gravestone, large.

jobs.name: g050
jobs.ja: 都市の番人（地下50階の門番）
jobs.prompt: Before the broken great gate of a ruined underground city stands a colossal guardian built of stone blocks and iron plates, towering over everything. In the middle of its chest a furnace core glows through an iron grille. {HERO} is tiny at its feet, seen from behind. Red only: the glowing furnace core in its chest.

jobs.name: e060
jobs.prompt: A crumbled throne room with dust and fallen pillars. On a broken throne sits a dried, mummified king, head slightly bowed, and on his head a crown still shines, untarnished. Large in the frame. Red only: the jewels set in the crown.

jobs.name: n01
jobs.prompt: The cracked wall of a collapsed government hall. A single large proclamation is pasted on it, faded and torn, its text blurred into illegible grey smudges with no readable letters, and a royal seal at the bottom. {HERO} holds up the lantern to read it. Red only: the wax royal seal at the bottom of the proclamation, large.

jobs.name: n03
jobs.prompt: In a corner of a ruin, {KNIGHT} has taken off his helmet and holds it in both hands against his chest. Above the neck of the armour there is no head at all, only empty darkness. Side view, quiet and sorrowful, large in the frame. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard.

jobs.name: n04
jobs.prompt: The bottom of a deep crevice, where thousands of sealed envelopes lie piled like snow while more flutter down one by one from the darkness above. {HERO} stands knee-deep among them, holding one envelope. Red only: the wax seals on the envelopes nearest the viewer, all the same seal, drawn large.

jobs.name: e082
jobs.prompt: A chamber made of organic flesh. In its centre a gigantic heart beats, its veins spreading across the walls and floor. A large glowing crystal is embedded in the heart's surface. {HERO} stands small before it. Red only: the glowing crystal and the veins closest to it.

jobs.name: e095
jobs.prompt: Pure darkness that seems to pulse like the inside of a living body, with faint curved membranes. In the centre the darkness bulges as if something small is moving inside, and faint small bare footprints on the floor lead into it. {HERO} stands at the edge with the lantern lowered. Red only: a red heartbeat glow at the centre of the darkness.

jobs.name: clear
jobs.prompt: A wide shaft of pale light pours down from far above into the darkness. {HERO} stands in the light with both arms raised, seen from behind, looking up toward the surface, dust drifting in the light. Red only: a single small red flower blooming at the adventurer's feet, drawn large enough to see.

jobs.name: e012_2_ng
jobs.ja: 蜘蛛の巣→繭を切り開く（失敗）：子蜘蛛があふれ出す
jobs.prompt: Close-up: a silk cocoon has burst open and a flood of countless small spiders pours out over {HERO}, who recoils and slashes with the short sword. Red only: the eyes of the spiders, shown as many bold red dots.

jobs.name: e045_0_r
jobs.ja: 薄れゆく亡霊→剣を受け継ぐ：騎士が剣に宿る
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT} dissolves into streams of light that flow into a sword held up by {HERO}; the blade begins to glow. Light trails run from the fading armour into the blade. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard of the fading knight.

jobs.name: e027_2_r
jobs.ja: 子守唄→少女の霊に任せる：少女が揺りかごに歌う
jobs.prompt: {GIRL} leans over an ornate wooden cradle and sings softly to it, both hands on its edge, a faint glow around her. {HERO} stands back in the shadows, watching. Red only: the crown crest carved on the cradle's headboard, large.

jobs.name: g100_1_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→少女を母のもとへ還す：母と娘
jobs.prompt: In a dark chamber of flesh, {QUEEN} emerges from the flesh wall, her body unravelling free of it, and embraces {GIRL}; both sing with their eyes closed and begin to rise as motes of light. Their faces are clearly lit and readable. Behind them the giant eye withers and shrivels. Red only: the iris of the withering giant eye.

jobs.name: g100_4_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→闇そのものを討つ：地上の光の中で目覚める
jobs.prompt: {HERO} lies collapsed on grass just outside the dark mouth of the labyrinth, under the bright light of the surface, the sword still in hand, dust drifting in the air. Red only: a red wildflower blooming next to the adventurer's hand, drawn large.

jobs.name: e011
jobs.prompt: A stone corridor where the floor has collapsed into a wide black pit with no visible bottom. The far edge looks reachable with a running jump. {HERO} stands at the near edge, looking across. Red only: a faint red glow deep down in the pit.

jobs.name: e014
jobs.prompt: Black slime drips from the cave ceiling and gathers into one glistening, oozing mass on the floor. Half-dissolved bones and pieces of armour float inside it. {HERO} steps back at the left. Red only: a glowing core inside the slime.

jobs.name: e015
jobs.prompt: A collapsed chapel with broken pews. A monk in a ragged hooded habit kneels in prayer before a cracked altar and has just turned his head toward the viewer; his eyes are clouded milky white. Large in the frame. Red only: a small votive candle flame on the altar.

jobs.name: e016
jobs.prompt: A stone staircase leading down breaks off halfway, collapsed into rubble. Through the gaps between the fallen blocks an even deeper darkness is visible. {HERO} stands at the top of the remaining steps. Red only: a faint red glow far below in the gaps.

jobs.name: e017
jobs.prompt: A human face pushes out of a stone wall, as if part of the stone itself; not a carving. Its eyelids twitch and its lips move, pleading. {HERO} holds up the lantern toward it. The face is large in the frame. Red only: a thin trickle of blood from the corner of the face's mouth.

jobs.name: e018
jobs.prompt: A cave floor covered with a cluster of glowing pale mushrooms of many sizes, their light the brightest thing in the scene, with sweet-looking spores drifting up. {HERO} crouches nearby, reaching toward one. Red only: the spotted cap of the single largest mushroom.

jobs.name: e019
jobs.prompt: An iron cage hangs from the ceiling of a dark stone room on a heavy chain. Inside, a gaunt, starving man crouches, reaching a bony hand through the bars toward the viewer. {HERO} stands below. Red only: the rusted padlock on the cage door.

jobs.name: e022
jobs.prompt: Cold water flows from a crack in the rock and forms a small clear pool in a cave. On the bottom of the pool something glows white. {HERO} kneels at the edge, looking in. Red only: a small red stone glinting next to the white glow at the bottom of the pool.

jobs.name: e024
jobs.prompt: A cave ceiling covered by thousands of bats; at the moment one takes flight, the whole swarm erupts into the air like a storm of black wings. {HERO} shields their face below. Red only: the eyes of the nearest bats, a few bold dots.

jobs.name: e025
jobs.prompt: Across a small wooden table, a grinning skeleton in a battered tricorn hat throws dice from a bony hand, coins piled before it, inviting the viewer to play. A single candle lights the table. Large in the frame. Red only: the dice, mid-roll.

jobs.name: e026
jobs.prompt: A long grey stone corridor, entirely grey, and in its wall a single door painted a vivid, unnaturally bright red. The door seems to pulse slightly. {HERO} stands before it, hand raised to touch it. Red only: the door; this is the one scene where the red element may be large.

jobs.name: e028
jobs.prompt: A stone statue of a goddess with a serene face in a ruined shrine; tears flow continuously from both of her eyes and run down her cheeks and robes onto a plinth. The plinth has a carved inscription shown only as worn, illegible marks. Large in the frame. Red only: the tears running from her eyes.

jobs.name: e029
jobs.prompt: From behind a boulder in a cave, a rough bandit with a scarf over the lower half of his face steps out, pointing a dagger at the viewer, with a menacing stance. Large in the frame. Red only: the scarf over his face.

jobs.name: e030
jobs.prompt: A crystal ball glows faintly on a stone pedestal in a dark room. Inside the ball a tiny image can be seen: a hooded figure lying dead on the ground. {HERO} leans over it, the glow lighting the edge of the hood. Red only: a small pool of blood beside the tiny dead figure inside the ball.

jobs.name: e032
jobs.prompt: In the centre of a room, a shining silver sword is stuck in a large rock, lit from above. Around the rock lie several skeletons, still reaching toward the sword's hilt. No living people. Red only: a gem in the sword's pommel.

jobs.name: n06
jobs.prompt: In the middle of a stone dungeon passage there is suddenly a city street corner: cobblestones, an iron street lamp and shuttered windows of a royal capital, as if cut out and placed here. The edges of the street fade into dungeon rock. On a wall there is a scrawled message shown only as illegible scratches. {HERO} stands under the street lamp. Red only: the flame of the street lamp.

jobs.name: e033
jobs.prompt: An ossuary whose walls are stacked from floor to ceiling with skulls, every one with its jaw wide open as if screaming. A narrow passage runs between them. {HERO} walks through, small. Red only: the eye sockets of a single skull in the centre glow faintly red.

jobs.name: e034
jobs.prompt: A pale, drifting ghost in a long tattered shroud wanders down a crypt corridor. It has no face, only a smooth blank surface where the face should be, and it tilts its head slowly toward the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: a red ribbon tied around the ghost's wrist.

jobs.name: e035
jobs.prompt: A black coffin on a stone slab in a crypt, nailed shut with dozens of nails driven in at all angles. Scratch marks are visible at its edges, as if from inside. On its lid a warning is smeared in blood, shown only as a rough illegible smear, not letters. Red only: the blood smear on the lid.

jobs.name: e036
jobs.prompt: A vaulted corridor flooded with black water up to chest height. Just beneath the surface a long, thin, serpent-like shape glides past. {HERO} wades through, lantern held high. Red only: a single eye of the shape under the water.

jobs.name: e038
jobs.prompt: A thin, emaciated ghoul crouches on all fours in a crypt, devouring a carcass, and slowly turns its head to grin at the viewer with a dripping mouth. Grotesque and realistic. Large in the frame. Red only: the blood on its mouth and hands.

jobs.name: e040
jobs.prompt: A porcelain doll in an old-fashioned dress sits on a small wooden chair in an empty dark room, its head turned toward the viewer, cracked face, glass eyes. Lit by a single beam. Large in the frame. Red only: the doll's painted lips.

jobs.name: e041
jobs.prompt: A long gallery lined with portraits in ornate frames. At the end hangs a final portrait showing a hooded figure, the same as the adventurer but very old and withered. {HERO} stands before it, looking up. Red only: the eyes of the old figure in the last portrait.

jobs.name: e042
jobs.prompt: A rotting rope bridge spans a bottomless chasm, swaying though there is no wind, as if something below is shaking it. Pale hands reach up from the darkness below toward the planks. {HERO} stands at the near end. Red only: a red cloth tied to the near post of the bridge.

jobs.name: e043
jobs.prompt: An abandoned alchemist's workshop: shelves crowded with bottles of many shapes, glass tubes and a cold furnace. On the empty desk stand three bottles side by side next to a note whose writing is only illegible scratches. No people. Red only: the liquid in one of the three bottles on the desk.

jobs.name: e044
jobs.prompt: A long banquet table laden with a lavish feast, with skeletons seated in every chair, some raising goblets. One chair is empty and turned toward the viewer, with a name card on the plate in front of it (no readable letters). Candelabras. Red only: the wine in the goblets.

jobs.name: e047
jobs.prompt: Deep inside a dungeon cell, a man chained to the wall hangs his head; he has just raised his face, and where his eyes should be there are only empty dark hollows. Large in the frame. Red only: the rusted shackles on his wrists.

jobs.name: e048
jobs.prompt: A huge jailer patrols in front of iron bars, a giant ring of keys hanging from his belt. Above his shoulders there is nothing: he has no head. He carries a lantern. Large in the frame. Red only: the light of his lantern.

jobs.name: e049
jobs.prompt: A corridor lined on both sides with countless lit candles of all sizes stretching into the distance, wax dripping onto the floor. A few candles have just gone out, trailing smoke. {HERO} walks down the middle, small. Red only: the flames of the candles nearest to the viewer.

jobs.name: e050
jobs.prompt: In the darkness at the back of a cave, a gigantic eye the size of a house has opened, its pupil slowly focusing on the viewer. {HERO} stands tiny before it, seen from behind. Red only: the veins around the eye.

jobs.name: e051
jobs.prompt: Between tall bookshelves, a dried, mummified man still gripping a pen sits slumped over a desk. On the desk lies an unfinished map of the labyrinth drawn as maze-like lines, no writing. No living people. Red only: the last line of the map, drawn in blood.

jobs.name: e052
jobs.prompt: A forbidden library where books are bound to the shelves with chains. One book thrashes violently against its chains, its cover made of stretched leather bearing a human face. {HERO} watches from the aisle. Red only: the open mouth of the face on the book's cover.

jobs.name: e053
jobs.prompt: On a rock in the middle of an underground lake sits a beautiful pale woman in a long tattered dress with long wet hair, singing. Her reflection in the water is a drowned skeleton. {HERO} stands on the shore, drawn toward her. Red only: her lips.

jobs.name: e054
jobs.prompt: A black-robed figure with a large scythe sits at a chessboard on a table in a crypt; under the hood is a skull. It gestures for the viewer to take the empty seat. Large in the frame. Red only: one chess piece, a king, on the board.

jobs.name: e055
jobs.prompt: A crypt floor entirely covered by a white, writhing carpet of maggots. Beneath them lies the vast carcass of some creature, its swollen belly slowly rising and falling as if still breathing. {HERO} stands at the edge, small. Red only: a gash in the carcass.

jobs.name: e056
jobs.prompt: On a stone floor in a corridor lies another handwritten note, the writing shown only as illegible scratches, with a pressed flower tucked into it. Far down the corridor, in the darkness, a faint silhouette of armour can be seen. {HERO} kneels to pick up the note. Red only: the pressed flower.

jobs.name: e057
jobs.prompt: A heavy wooden door where the handle should be, there is a wet, fleshy mouth with teeth, open and speaking, drool running down the wood. {HERO} stands before it. Large in the frame. Red only: the tongue inside the mouth.

jobs.name: e058
jobs.prompt: A forest of giant mushrooms reaching up to the cave ceiling, spores falling like snow and piling on the ground. Deep in the forest, dim shapes. {HERO} walks in with a cloth over their mouth, small. Red only: one small glowing light deep in the forest.

jobs.name: e059
jobs.prompt: A grand avenue of an underground city lined with stone houses exactly like a royal capital, but drained of all colour. Every window is lit and shows the silhouette of a person moving, yet the doors stand open on empty rooms. {HERO} walks down the middle of the avenue, small. Red only: one single lit window.

jobs.name: e061
jobs.prompt: A gigantic moth descends with its wings spread, glowing with a ghostly light. The patterns on its wings are made of countless human faces. {HERO} stands below, small. Red only: the moth's two large eyes.

jobs.name: e062
jobs.prompt: A man with mushrooms growing all over his body walks slowly toward the viewer with open arms; thread-like fungal tendrils reach out from his chest. Grotesque and realistic. Large in the frame. Red only: the caps of a few mushrooms on his shoulders.

jobs.name: e063
jobs.prompt: The huge clock face of a ruined clock tower in an underground city, its hands turning the wrong way. Below the clock face is a small door with a carved inscription shown only as illegible marks. {HERO} stands before the door, small. Red only: the hands of the clock.

jobs.name: e064
jobs.prompt: A cathedral built of black obsidian. On the altar a black flame burns with a dark glow. The pews are empty of people, but shadows sit in them, praying. {HERO} stands in the aisle. Red only: the outline of the black flame.

jobs.name: e065
jobs.prompt: Two identical doors side by side in a corridor; one is carved with an open eye, the other with a closed eye (no words). In front of them stand pale twin children in identical old-fashioned clothes, speaking at the same time, with unsettling smiles. Large in the frame. Red only: the ribbons in the twins' hair.

jobs.name: e066
jobs.prompt: The enormous skeleton of a dragon lies across a whole cave. Inside its ribcage, a pile of treasure glints dully. Hot air shimmers up from gaps between the bones. {HERO} stands small at the dragon's skull. Red only: a large gem at the top of the treasure pile.

jobs.name: e067
jobs.prompt: {HERO} stands in a ruin, and their own shadow on the floor has risen up by itself into a standing black figure with the same shape, facing them. The shadow speaks. Both large in the frame. Red only: the shadow's two eyes.

jobs.name: e068
jobs.prompt: A merchant wearing many masks layered over one another runs a small stall in a ruined street; the stall is covered with hanging masks of human faces. The merchant leans forward to greet the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: the mouth of the outermost mask.

jobs.name: e069
jobs.prompt: A huge egg wrapped in fungal threads, pulsing like a heart, in a fungus-filled cave. Cracks run across its shell, and something is knocking from inside. {HERO} stands small before it. Red only: the light leaking out of the cracks.

jobs.name: e070
jobs.prompt: A column of dead soldiers in rusted armour marches toward the viewer through a ruined street, none of them alive, empty helmets. The standard-bearer at the front has stopped and looks straight at the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: the tattered banner carried by the standard-bearer.

jobs.name: e071
jobs.prompt: The same swamp witch as before, a hunched old crone with wild grey hair, stirs her bubbling cauldron in a cave hut and looks up with a knowing, crooked grin, as if remembering the viewer. Hourglasses and bones hang around her. Realistic and grotesque. Large in the frame. Red only: the sand in one hourglass.
